healthver.granularity: one supplied evidence statement and one claim per row
healthver.task_fit: NLI evidence-pair classification only; no equivalent abstract corpus, BM25 document retrieval task, or claim-level evidence aggregation for F4/F5
healthver.license_audit: no LICENSE file was present at the audited commit
healthver.exclusion_reason: Neutral is a labeled relation, not missing evidence or E1 NO_RELATION; arbitrary conversion would change the task and F4 is undefined
